RandRoute.notes: Outputs 0 to 3 are not placed on the panel and are left untagged. The routed input and the four outputs carry whatever is patched, so they are given no family. The two Mode menu names are swapped against what they do. The menu is built as createIndexPtrSubmenuItem("Mode", {"Latch", "Toggle"}, &module->toggle), so picking Latch sets toggle false and picking Toggle sets it true. With toggle false the chosen output is gateOut = rollDice && gate, which passes the input gate through and falls to 0V the moment the gate does — gating, not latching. With toggle true the gate term drops out and the chosen output stays at 10V until another output is chosen — which is the latch. Our line describes the behaviour as the code has it and names the conflict in one clause.
